titles: copies the prompt, reads a pasted answer, fixes or leaves out every unread line, and saves with no network call

behaviors: The prompt is copied in one tap and the format is stated by the app.
A pasted answer with fictitious names is read into the same review as a scan; every pasted row needs its own check and the count must be confirmed.
Unread lines stay visible with their text and reason; each is fixed in place (Rileggi riga) or left out explicitly before saving.
The journey fails on any request to a foreign host, any non-GET request, or any request URL that carries a pasted value.
physicalDevice: Not run; the owner tries the path with the assistant the centre will use at UG2.
